title: Germline EGFR T790M mutation and lung cancer risk
title_zh: 胚系 EGFR T790M 变异与肺癌风险
abstract: Most lung cancers are tobacco related, with genetic factors influencing smoking behavior identified through genome-wide association studies. However, inherited risk in familial and non-smoking-related lung cancers, including risk in carriers of EGFR T790M, remains poorly understood. Here, in more than 3.3 million individuals, the EGFR T790M germline variant is significantly associated with lung cancer risk, with no increased risk for 17 other cancers and no interaction with polygenic risk. This risk exceeds that conferred by smoking and is several-fold higher in never-smokers. Global geographic and ancestry analyses show higher T790M prevalence in the US than in British- and Irish-descendant populations, reflecting a Southern Appalachian founder event about 200 to 225 years ago, increasing regional prevalence and affecting those of British, Irish, and African descent. Recognition of high-risk carriers may inform targeted genetic testing and screening strategies.
abstract_zh: 大多数肺癌与吸烟相关，基因组全关联研究已识别影响吸烟行为的遗传因素。然而，家族性和非吸烟相关肺癌的遗传风险，包括携带 EGFR T790M 的个体风险，仍不清楚。本文在超过330万人中发现，EGFR T790M 胚系变异与肺癌风险显著相关，且未与其他17种癌症风险相关，也未与多基因风险交互。该风险超过吸烟所致风险，在从不吸烟者中更高数倍。全球地理和祖源分析显示，美国的 T790M 流行率高于英国和爱尔兰后裔人群，反映约200至225年前南阿巴拉契亚地区的创始人事件，提升了该地区的流行率，并影响英国、爱尔兰和非洲后裔。识别高风险携带者可为靶向基因检测和筛查策略提供依据。
